Paynani is missing permissions to receive and send SMS and to see calls. Without them nothing reaches paynani. Grant them now?
Paynani passes your SMS and calls to your paynani agent and sends its replies. Nothing else leaves the phone. It needs:
SMS: receive messages, read the inbox to recover any the app missed, and send the agent\'s replies.
Phone: detect incoming calls and know which SIM a message arrived on.
Call log: see the number of a missed or answered call.
Notifications: show whether the phone is connected to paynani.
Battery: run without battery optimization, so Android does not cut the connection to paynani.
Turn off RCS chats in Google Messages: messages that arrive over RCS do not travel as SMS, so Paynani cannot see them. Status tells you if this is pending.

Messages that arrive over RCS travel over data inside Google Messages, never as SMS, so Paynani cannot see them.

1. Open Google Messages.
2. Tap your profile picture, then Messages settings.
3. Tap RCS chats and turn off "Turn on RCS chats".

If this number used RCS before, also deregister it at messages.google.com/disable-chat.

Google warns that turning off RCS takes you out of RCS group chats.

Do not leave a conversation open in Google Messages on the gateway phone: with the conversation open, Android does not announce the message and Paynani cannot detect an RCS.

Samsung can put Paynani to sleep, and then it stops receiving and sending SMS until someone opens it.

1. «Open settings» takes you to Paynani's screen: in Battery, choose «Unrestricted».
2. Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, «Never sleeping apps»: tap + and add Paynani.

Do not add it to «Sleeping apps» or «Deep sleeping apps»: those lists put it to sleep.

Samsung can put Paynani to sleep, and then it stops receiving and sending SMS until someone opens it.

1. «Open settings» takes you to Paynani's screen. In Battery, «Allow background activity» must be On, and «Optimize battery usage» must say «Not optimized».
2. Settings, Device maintenance, Battery, ⋮, Settings: make sure Paynani is not in «Sleeping apps» or «Disabled apps». If it is there, remove it.

If Samsung keeps putting it there, turn off «Put unused apps to sleep» and «Auto disable unused apps» on that same screen.

Samsung can put Paynani to sleep, and then it stops receiving and sending SMS until someone opens it.

1. «Open settings» takes you to Paynani's screen. In Battery, «Allow background activity» must be On.
2. Settings, Device care, Battery, App power management, «Apps that won't be put to sleep»: tap Add and choose Paynani.

Do not add it to «Sleeping apps»: that list puts it to sleep.

Catch-All: messages from numbers outside the roster

With a channel\'s Catch-All on, that channel\'s messages from people who are not on the roster reach your agent with their text. The agent follows only those instructions and never replies to them.\n\nVerification codes (WhatsApp, Telegram, banks) will reach the agent too. Your instructions can tell it to ignore them.
For example: tell me on Telegram who wrote and what they said.
